prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game sprite atlas for a fruit slicing arcade game. Generate one transparent PNG sprite sheet, 3 columns by 4 rows, with twelve equally sized square cells on a perfectly regular grid. Portrait canvas aspect ratio 3:4. Row 1 red apple; row 2 orange; row 3 striped green watermelon; row 4 fuzzy brown kiwi. Every row: column 1 one whole fruit, column 2 the left half of that fruit showing juicy cut flesh, column 3 the right half showing juicy cut flesh. Halves are individual isolated pieces, not two halves together. Consistent hand-painted cartoon game style, saturated appetizing colors, soft dimensional highlights, crisp readable silhouette, top-left lighting, modest dark outline. Front three-quarter view with readable cut surfaces. Each sprite centered in its cell, fit inside the central 70% of its cell, keep ample fully transparent gutters. Whole fruits same apparent diameter. Watermelon halves vivid red flesh and black seeds; orange halves segmented orange flesh; apple halves creamy flesh and brown seeds; kiwi halves bright green radial flesh and tiny black seeds. Absolutely no text, labels, grid lines, borders, background, scenery, decorative splashes, cast ground shadows, logos or watermark. Real alpha transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game item sprite atlas. Generate one transparent PNG sprite sheet with exactly TWO equally sized square cells side by side (2:1 landscape canvas). Left cell: a single round black cartoon bomb with a short lit rope fuse and tiny warm spark, shiny charcoal casing, no letters. Right cell: a single mint-turquoise and gold stopwatch power-up with a clear white dial, two dark hands, a top crown, small glowing mint accent, NO digits and no letters. Match a premium hand-painted cartoon fruit-slicing arcade game: saturated colors, soft 3D highlights, subtle dark edges, top-left lighting, front three-quarter view. Each object centered in its own cell and fits inside its central 70%, with large transparent gutters, no overlap. No background, no floor shadow, no grid, no text, no labels, no watermark. Real alpha transparency.
